description: This file defines a Java interface 'FileGet' that declares methods for retrieving static content files in a Content Management System (CMS) context. It includes method signatures for getting a file, listing file names, and listing files based on merchant store code and content type.

classes.name: FileGet
classes.description: A Java interface providing methods to retrieve static content files from a CMS system, identified by merchant store code and content type.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific static content file based on merchant store code, content type, and content name.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of file names for static content files of a given content type and merchant store code.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of static content files for a specific merchant store and content type.
